root_cause: Installing a full Debian JRE inside a layer over the 5.79 GB frozen parent adds enough copy-up to breach the strict 8 GiB cumulative PX cap, even with 825 MB of measured headroom.
smaller_layer_plan: build a pinned minimal JRE archive once in a guarded donor job using jlink with only java.base, java.logging and java.xml modules
record the runtime archive SHA-256 and the jlink command; do not rely on apt in the tool image
trim the BBTools tree to the files tadpole.sh actually loads, preserving every sequence byte; verify the trimmed tree SHA-256 and a zero-contig FASTA unit case
single-layer image: COPY trimmed BBTools + minimal JRE + two adapter files, verify all hashes in-image, symlink tadpole.sh onto PATH
no reference, truth, panel or evaluator input in argv or environment
acceptance: image layer delta small enough for admit() with a 1 GiB reservation
physical PX-R053 and synthetic PX-H452 canaries under the guard
